entities.summary: Sergei Nikolayevich Strunnikov was a Soviet photographer, master of reportage and photo portraiture. He was the author of the photograph of Zoya Kosmodemyanskaya's body, shots of the Battle of Moscow, life in besieged Leningrad, the Battle of Stalingrad, and other historical photographs.
